reason: def-maincb-raw-call requires a recorded raw-defect number d_raw as part of the datum. The node's purported constructor records the global-scalar tag, source, target, scale t, target defect epsilon, literal map, and fixed amplifications, but supplies no d_raw, then incorrectly concludes that those fields make an explicit raw call. The fact that u_0 is an extended D_*t-inclusion is a separate asserted property and does not itself assign the required recorded datum field; the definition expressly warns that the recorded number and extended-inclusion assertion are distinct. Thus the claimed raw-call typing does not follow unless the proof explicitly chooses and records a raw-defect value (for example d_raw=D_*t, if intended).
